==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=MicrosoftLogging&min=MicrosoftLogging&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Verify.MicrosoftLogging: entries logged while a recording is running are appended to the
        // snapshot under the name log.
        // Called explicitly so it runs before Verify.NServiceBus, which initializes it itself when
        // it has not already run.
        VerifyMicrosoftLogging.Initialize();

        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Extensions/MicrosoftLoggingTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=MicrosoftLogging&min=MicrosoftLogging&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using VerifyTests.MicrosoftLogging;

// Verify.MicrosoftLogging: Records what the code under test logged through ILogger and appends it to the snapshot.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.MicrosoftLogging
// Note: Nothing is captured unless Recording.Start() has run, and Recording.Add throws for
// anything logged outside a recording, so start the recording before the code under test logs.
// Note: The readme's LoggerRecording and LoggerProvider types do not exist; the API is
// Recording.Start(), RecordingLogger and RecordingProvider.
// Note: Every logging extension records under the name log, so entries from two of them interleave
// and Recording.IgnoreNames cannot separate them.
// Note: Scopes are recorded as StartScope and EndScope entries around the entries they contain.
// Note: Verify.NServiceBus depends on this package and initializes it itself unless it has already
// run.
public class MicrosoftLoggingTests
{
    // The recording starts before anything logs: Recording.Add throws for an entry written
    // outside a recording, so a logger handed out earlier would fail the test.
    // Only the result is passed to Verify; the log entries are appended under log on their own.
    [Fact]
    public Task Logging()
    {
        Recording.Start();
        var logger = new RecordingLogger();
        var target = new ClassThatUsesLogging(logger);

        var result = target.Method();

        return Verify(result);
    }
}
